score_interpretation: CKD-review score calibrated to documented CKD; not probability of verified true CKD
shap_interpretation: Contributions explain the ensemble mean raw margin and do not add directly to the displayed percentage
instructions: Review the same clinical information with the locked model output.
Treat the score as support for review, not as a probability of verified true CKD or a diagnosis.
SHAP directions describe model behavior and not causal effects.
Record information sufficiency separately from the revised binary recommendation.
